project.title: Aquascape substrates v2
project.description: Four independently generated full-resolution substrate textures added to the accepted warm fine sand experiment. Local material painting and batched surface gravel, retaining two existing large rock models.
project.art_direction: Match the accepted warm sand reference and established naturalistic pixel aquarium artwork. Different materials must remain distinct in hue, grain shape and grain scale.

brief.name: quartz_white
brief.description: Create ONE seamless tileable aquarium substrate material, exact straight-down orthographic view of a flat densely packed surface, full bleed square 1024x1024. Match the supplied accepted sand illustration for fine deliberate PIXEL ART clusters, naturalistic painted material, controlled palette and readable grains. No photo, no smooth CGI, no uniform procedural noise. No borders, labels, inset, plants, fish, equipment, large rocks, sand hills or white studio background. All four image edges should tile continuously. Broad overall even color, no large blobs, no directional gradients, no large cast shadows. Very subtle diffuse grain shading; later real geometry supplies larger shadows. Warm ivory-white quartz aquarium sand. Clearly pale ivory rather than yellow beige; a few very pale gray and translucent quartz grains, delicate cool gray separations, no pure white blown-out areas. Fine rounded irregular mineral grains mostly 2-5 pixels across. Restrained low contrast and no large pebbles.

stages.notes: Pure-white validate must pass before trim/matte.
